name: g60_sub_weak
purpose: Substitute at the boundary (decision 0032, data/moves.ts:18319): Gengar (M) with 4 * hp == maxhp puts a Substitute up, Garchomp's Dragon Claw breaks it, and the user's next Substitute at a quarter of its maximum HP fails with [weak]; the three Substitutes before cost a quarter each, so the user goes down to exactly maxhp / 4.
